name: devmesh
description: An evidence-based AI software engineering orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, full-stack builds, Browser QA, IDX/MLS/RESO workflows, and a WordPress Real Estate Specialist for site health, plugins/themes, WP-CLI, REST, safe updates, IDX search, freshness, security, performance, lead QA, and client handover.

interface.shortDescription: Mission Control + WordPress Real Estate engineering specialist
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v0.9 adds a WordPress Real Estate Specialist with Site Health diagnostics, plugin/theme conflict isolation, safe staged updates, WP-CLI operation, WordPress REST integration, IDX provider detection, WordPress-to-MLS bridging, property search QA, listing freshness monitoring, IDX/VOW/compliance monitoring, WordPress performance/security review, lead-flow QA, and client handover. It builds on Mission Control, full-stack, RESO/IDX/MLS, Browser QA, CI, security, accessibility, performance, incident, deployment, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery workflows. Codex uses the plugin adapter; ChatGPT uses the portable Agent Skills adapter.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Deep: act as a WordPress Real Estate Website Specialist and audit this site end-to-end with evidence.
Use DevMesh to diagnose this WordPress/IDX issue, prove the root cause, fix it safely, and retest the affected flow.
Use DevMesh to audit this IDX/MLS website using the actual provider rules, listing freshness, search UX, security, performance, and lead delivery evidence.
